subject: Re: PII handling for prompts/outputs — confirmation & next steps
messages:
From: Alice Jones <alice.jones@sunnysidehealth.com>

Subject: PII handling for prompts/outputs — follow-up from demo

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo today — very helpful. A couple of follow-ups from our side around data handling / privacy as we start to scope a POC:

- Can you confirm whether Redwood stores prompts and model outputs for hosted API traffic? If so, what specifically is stored (full prompt text, outputs, metadata)?
- What are the default retention windows for logs that include prompts/outputs? Is that configurable per-account or per-deployment?
- Where are logs and persisted artifacts stored by default (region/cloud)? We need to confirm US-only residency for PHI-adjacent data.
- What logging controls do you offer (redaction, token-level masking, opt-out of storing prompt/output content)?

Attaching our security questionnaire and a short doc with the fields our legal team needs filled. Would you be able to confirm in writing (can be a short email) the default behavior and options for Dedicated/Private deployments?

Thanks,
Alice Jones
Head of Platform Integrations
Sunnyside Health

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Legal Team <legal@sunnysidehealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-18T17:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PII handling for prompts/outputs — follow-up from demo

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear summary and the questionnaire. Quick post-call recap and high-level answers so you have something to share with legal:

- What is stored: For our Hosted API (default), request metadata (timestamps, model used, token counts) and request/response payloads may be logged for telemetry and safety by default. Full prompt text and model outputs are included in those logs unless the customer opts into a retention/telemetry opt-out (available on enterprise plans).
- Retention: Default retention for logs that may contain prompts/outputs is 30 days. Retention is configurable on Dedicated and Private deployments and can be reduced to meet contractual needs.
- Residency: Default storage region is US (us-east-1) for US customers. We support EU and APAC residency options and can route logs to the region you specify.
- Controls: We offer configurable logging controls: token-level redaction, prefix-only caching, and the ability to disable persistent storage of prompt/output content for production traffic on Dedicated/Private deployments. Hosted customers can request a telemetry opt-out via contract.

Next steps: Neha (cc'd) runs point on security/compliance — she can provide a short data handling summary and the specific language your legal team will need for the BAA/contract. I can also set up a short tech call next week to go through the Dedicated vs Private options and their trade-offs for residency and retention.

I'll attach a short one-pager with the high-level data handling points for quick review.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-data-handling-summary.pdf

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alice Jones <alice.jones@sunnysidehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Legal Team <legal@sunnysidehealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-19T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PII handling for prompts/outputs — confirmation & next steps

Hi Alice — following up with a more detailed breakdown you can pass to your security/legal team. This is intended to be high-fidelity but non-contractual; we can turn it into attestation language for the BAA as needed.

Summary (what is stored by deployment type):
- Hosted (Redwood API):
  * Metadata: retained by default (request id, timestamps, model, client id) — retention 30 days.
  * Payloads (prompts/outputs): included in logs by default for telemetry and safety. Retention 30 days.
  * Controls: telemetry opt-out available under enterprise contract; we can disable storage of prompt/output content and keep only metadata.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity in our cloud):
  * Metadata: retained per account policy — configurable.
  * Payloads: retention and persistence configurable; we can disable persistent logging of prompts/outputs and/or route logs to your own S3 bucket.
  * Controls: stronger tenancy isolation; option for customer-managed KMS for at-rest encryption.
- Private (VPC or on-prem):
  * All data is under customer control; logs/retention are controlled by your infra and our private control plane. We support air-gapped on-prem installs for regulated customers.

Residency and locations: by default we use AWS us-east-1 for US customers. For EU customers we use eu-west-1 (or equivalent). We can set up region-specific routing for logs and model artifacts; customer must choose residency in contract for regulated data (PHI).

Retention specifics and redaction options:
- Default hosted retention: 30 days (can be shortened).
- For Dedicated/Private we can set retention to a customer-specified window (e.g., 7/14/30 days) or implement automated deletion policies.
- Redaction: token-level masking and configurable rules (PII patterns). We also support prompt-output scrubbing pipelines before persisting logs.

Logging controls and audit:
- Audit logs show who accessed logs and when; retention of audit logs is configurable.
- We provide SOC 2 Type II report and can share a SOC 2 pack under NDA.

Requested artifacts / next steps:
1) I can produce a one-page attestation that states: "Redwood will not persist prompt/output content for production traffic under the agreed contract when telemetry opt-out is selected; logs will be limited to metadata and will be stored in us-east-1 with retention X days." Let me know the exact retention requirement and residency you need.
2) If you require, we can provide a Dedicated proof-of-concept with logs routed to your S3 and KMS.
3) We can route a draft BAA to your legal team (DocuSign link below) and fill it with the exact data retention/residency language you confirm.

Links: Data handling summary (internal): https://drive.google.com/redwood/data-handling-summary
DocuSign draft BAA: https://app.docusign.com/BAA-Redwood-000123

Happy to jump on a short call to finalize the retention window and the technical steps for a POC.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks Neha — this is exactly what we need. A couple of quick clarifications before I loop legal: 

- Can you confirm in writing that Redwood can disable persistent storage of prompt/output content for production traffic (not just for POC) when the telemetry opt-out is selected?
- If yes, can you also confirm whether that will impact model quality monitoring or our ability to use Redwood Optimize? If there is an impact, we need to understand trade-offs.
- Residency: we need logs and any persisted artifacts to remain in US-only (us-east-1). Please confirm you will bake that into the contract language.

If you can confirm the three items above in writing, I’ll have legal proceed with the BAA review (I’ve attached a short request sheet specific to our legal team). We are hoping to start a small POC in July.

Thanks,
Alice

Sunnyside Health
